cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的创建订单数、支付订单数、有效订单数和取消订单数分别是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN order_id END) AS paid_order_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END) AS valid_order_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN order_id END) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 青禾在 2026 年 8 月（按下单日期统计，覆盖 8 月 1 日至 8 月 31 日）的订单数分别为：创建订单数 34,306 单；支付订单数 31,564 单；有效订单数 29,933 单；取消订单数 2,742 单。口径说明：创建订单数按每个订单号计一次并包含取消单；支付订单数包含后来全部退款的订单；有效订单数要求已支付且实付金额减退款金额大于零，取消和全退不计；取消订单数按取消订单统计。本次结果属于当前已加载的青禾测试数据范围，未按门店筛选或分组；以上均为订单计数，不涉及金额换算。

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的退款订单数、部分退款订单数和全额退款订单数各是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END) AS refund_order_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN order_id END) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN order_id END) AS full_refund_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 2026 年 8 月，青禾当前测试数据范围内：退款订单数为 4,718 单，其中部分退款订单数 3,087 单，全额退款订单数 1,631 单。统计口径为已支付且退款金额大于零的订单；部分退款指退款金额大于零且小于实付金额，全额退款指实付金额大于零且退款金额等于实付金额。统计日期为 2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31（结束日期 2026-09-01 不包含），未按门店筛选或分组。
actual.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的退款订单数、部分退款订单数和全额退款订单数各是多少？

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的有效订单均额、购买会员人均消费、购买频次和单均商品件数是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 2026 年 8 月（按当前青禾客户数据统计，未按门店等维度拆分）：有效订单均额为 171.69 元/单；购买会员人均消费为 311.39 元/账户；购买频次为 1.81 单/账户；单均商品件数为 4.02 件/单。以上结果基于当前合成测试库覆盖范围计算。

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的退款金额占比、取消率、退款订单率和优惠率是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN order_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate

WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

cases.question: 青禾 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数和月内复购率，按月分别列出。

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', stat_period_start) AS metric_time__day
    , DATE_TRUNC('month', stat_period_start) AS metric_time__month
    , member_id AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN member_month_valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."valid_order_month_facts" valid_order_month_facts_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)
actual.answer:
青禾在 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的会员购买与复购情况如下（统计单位为 CRM 会员账户，均为完整自然月、全门店口径，两个月分别独立统计，不能将人数相加为跨月人数）：

- 2026 年 7 月：月内购买会员数 16,436 户；月内复购会员数 7,388 户；月内复购率 44.95%。
- 2026 年 8 月：月内购买会员数 16,504 户；月内复购会员数 7,302 户；月内复购率 44.24%。

口径说明：月内购买会员数为同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购会员数为同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购率=月内复购会员数÷月内购买会员数。

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', stat_period_start) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible THEN member_id END AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible THEN order_id END AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible AND member_month_valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."valid_order_month_facts" valid_order_month_facts_src_10000
)

SELECT

  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_repeat_rate) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_avg_order_value) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value

) subq_10

    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
    , CAST(SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
